name: just
why: Task runner and the single entry point for the local gate: every check is a recipe, and lefthook and CI call the recipes, so the lists cannot drift.
install: Linux: `snap install --classic just` or `cargo binstall -y just` · macOS: `brew install just` · Windows: `scoop install just`
gates: everything: the local gate (`just check`: tools-check, typos, license-check, line-citations, action-pins, actionlint, fmt-check, shellcheck, psanalyze, suppressions, drift, tools-doc-check, test), the pre-push hook, CI and the release workflow all route through the recipes it defines

name: lefthook
why: Git hooks. pre-push runs the same recipes as `just check`, in parallel; there is no pre-commit hook. Needs `lefthook install` once per clone (`just setup`).
install: Linux: release `.deb`/`.rpm` from github.com/evilmartians/lefthook/releases · macOS: `brew install lefthook` · Windows: `scoop install lefthook`

name: shellcheck
why: Lints every shell file as POSIX `sh` (`shellcheck -s sh`), the portability guard for `setup.sh`.
install: Linux: `apt install shellcheck` · macOS: `brew install shellcheck` · Windows: `scoop install shellcheck`
gates: `just check`; CI gates and release jobs

name: shfmt
why: Formats and checks shell files in the POSIX dialect (`-ln posix -i 2 -ci`); a hard gate.
install: Linux: `snap install shfmt` · macOS: `brew install shfmt` · Windows: `scoop install shfmt`
gates: `just check`; CI gates and release jobs

name: pwsh
why: PowerShell 7, used to run PSScriptAnalyzer and Pester from the justfile.
install: Linux: https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/scripting/install/installing-powershell-on-linux · macOS: `brew install powershell` · Windows: `winget install Microsoft.PowerShell`
gates: `just check`; CI gates, release and matrix jobs

name: PSScriptAnalyzer
why: PowerShell module that lints `*.ps1`, with `PSUseCompatibleSyntax` targeting Windows PowerShell 5.1. Pinned to 1.25.0.
gates: `just check`; CI gates and release jobs

name: Pester
why: PowerShell test framework, major version 5 or newer, for `tests/pester/`.
gates: `just check`; CI gates, release and matrix jobs

name: typos
install: Linux: `cargo binstall -y typos-cli` · macOS: `brew install typos-cli` · Windows: `scoop install typos`
gates: `just check`; CI gates and release jobs

name: actionlint
install: Linux and macOS: `go install github.com/rhysd/actionlint/cmd/actionlint@v1.7.12` or `brew install actionlint` · Windows: `scoop install actionlint`
gates: `just check`; CI gates and release jobs

name: addlicense
why: Checks that every source file carries `header.txt`.
gates: `just check`; CI gates and release jobs

name: jq
install: Linux: `apt install jq` · macOS: `brew install jq` · Windows: `scoop install jq`
gates: `just check`; CI gates and release jobs

name: python3
why: Test-only: serves the fake release server used by `test-integration`.
install: Linux: `apt install python3` · macOS: `brew install python` · Windows: `winget install Python.Python.3`

name: dash
why: Test-only, Linux: the strict POSIX shell the shell tests run under, alongside bash.
install: Linux: `apt install dash` (preinstalled on Debian and Ubuntu)
gates: `just check`; CI gates and release jobs
